description: Baseline measurement of agent-sync dotfiles management performance. Library contains 261 items (139 skills, 22 commands, 99 agents, 1 hook). Total sync time is dominated by file scanning and library enumeration operations.

Baseline measurement using cargo check time as proxy. cargo check completed in ~196ms (cached). Library has 261 items (139 skills, 22 commands, 99 agents, 1 hook). Sync time estimated from compilation proxy.

Added aesthetic-analysis and wireframe-to-3d skills from external sources. Library now contains 261 items (141 skills). Total sync time is 1,161,375 µs as measured through WSL agent-sync list operation.

Experiment #2: sorted_entries optimization - changed sort_by_key(fs::DirEntry::file_name) to sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name()). This is a syntactic change with no behavioral impact - the compiler generates identical code. Measurements ranged 830K-3M µs due to high WSL startup noise (process creation + file copying). This change should be discarded as it has no real effect.

asi.hypothesis: Changing sort_by_key syntax in sorted_entries would reduce overhead
asi.finding: This is a no-op change - compilers produce identical code for both forms. Measurements have high variance (300% between runs) due to WSL process creation overhead.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on real allocations and redundant filesystem checks instead of syntax changes
asi.wsl_overhead: Significant - each run spawns WSL process, copies binary to fs, then executes
